QCF V2 page fonts (p1.woff2, p2.woff2, p3.woff2, p50.woff2, p604.woff2)
are the property of King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex (KFGQPC).
Source copies used here come from Quran Foundation / quran.com
(https://verses.quran.foundation/fonts/quran/hafs/v2/woff2/).
They are bundled same-origin so the Medine page cannot paint a fallback
typeface (no FOUT / no reflow). Layout of lines and words is from
quran.com QDC / QUL. Hafızyol does not copy Ezan Vakti PNG or assets.
